summary: Keeps Mission Control execution markers synchronized with each imported BPMN diagram and qualifies the browser journey before image publication.
userImpact: Execution Trail loop and multi-instance markers appear reliably after navigating between process-instance detail pages.
Release operators receive the full Mission Control image-browser result before a release tag is created instead of discovering the same failure during public image publication.

instructions: Upgrade the frontend and backend images together to the patch release containing this fix.

notes: This fix does not change the TypeORM schema or migration sequence; candidate qualification continues to require equivalent behavior on PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, and Spanner.

documentation: The versioned release notes describe the BPMN import-readiness fix and the earlier image-browser qualification boundary.
rollback: Revert to the preceding matching frontend and backend images if necessary; execution markers may again render only after another unrelated detail-page update.
validation: Run the focused frontend regression for a BPMN element registry that becomes available after diagram import.

Run the Mission Control mock-engine browser journey against exact candidate PostgreSQL images and verify process overview, detail, BPMN, variables, execution markers, API responses, and browser console.
Run release workflow contract, classifier, and candidate-readiness checks before protected CI.
